purpose: One-time frozen Path A audio-text candidate-likelihood diagnostic on the existing fixed LibriSpeech four-choice task.

model.loading: local_files_only; no model download; FP32; evaluation mode

data.condition_ids_options_targets_and_target: reuse exactly from the existing fixed evaluation manifest
data.exposure: Previously inspected public dev-clean development IDs; not blind, not independent project-level evidence, and not sealed audit data.

scoring.question: Which exact transcript matches the spoken audio?
scoring.candidate_text: Use each supplied transcript verbatim after stripping only outer whitespace.
scoring.score: teacher-forced sum of log probabilities for transcript tokens plus end-of-text, divided by the number of transcript tokens plus end-of-text
scoring.probabilities: softmax of the four mean token log-likelihood scores; no fitted temperature or calibration

paired_uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap by LibriSpeech speaker ID

execution.archive_handling: read-only sequential tar stream; no extraction

baseline.identity: unchanged Path A Speech Commands Audio+Text readout, same fixed IDs and choices

claim_limits: This is a fixed-model development comparison, not a blind result or product release evaluation.
Whisper pretraining overlap with LibriSpeech is unknown; do not claim decontaminated generalization.
No general speech, arbitrary text reasoning, multimodal fusion, or 95-percent product claim follows from this narrow task.
